title: Console: Semantic Landmarks, ARIA Role Audit & IME-friendly Keyboard Navigation for Cost & Rollouts Views
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Finalize design changes that make the Console dashboards (Cost view, Rollouts, and per-route detail panels) accessible and localizable across major assistive tech and IME scenarios. This ticket covers: (1) introducing semantic landmarks and ARIA roles to improve screen reader navigation between the left nav, dashboard filters, charts, and rollout cards; (2) an audit and recommended mappings for ARIA attributes and live region semantics for streaming/tokenized outputs; (3) keyboard navigation patterns that respect IME composition events (e.g., on macOS/Windows with non-Latin input), avoid accidental activation during composition, and provide discoverable shortcuts for power users; (4) color token adjustments to meet WCAG AA/AAA contrast targets for important interactive states; (5) i18n readiness: ensure dynamic labels and number formats are announced correctly and that expansion doesn't break focus order or visual truncation on narrower locales.
comments: 2026-02-25 Maya Chen: Triage - Combined findings from user research and automated axe scans. Prioritized: keyboard/IME edge cases, semantic regions, chart ARIA labels, and cost-table number formatting announcements.

2026-02-28 Liam O'Neill: Design proposal posted — added alternative flows for VoiceOver rotor access and landmark labeling. Requesting engineering feedback on live-region volume for streaming logs in rollout details.

2026-03-02 Engineering (Sara Patel): Reviewed keyboard flows; noted that our global shortcut layer intercepts composition events in Chromium on Windows. Suggest adding compositionstart/compositionend guards in the global handler and deferring activation until compositionend.

2026-03-05 Design review: Updated Figma to include explicit role="navigation" and role="region" landmarks plus aria-labels for 'Cost filters', 'Rollout timeline', 'Route config'. Added visually hidden headings where needed for rotor grouping.

2026-03-07 PM (Ethan Ruiz): Confirmed this will be included in the March console release if engineering can complete the PR by 2026-03-18. Flagged potential dependence on the runtime release that changes streaming payload shapes — engineering to confirm.

2026-03-09 QA (Priya Singh): Ran VoiceOver and NVDA smoke tests on the prototype. Noted that formatted currency is read correctly in en-US but breaks for ja-JP locales because the currency symbol is trailing and the screen reader pauses; suggested explicit aria-label with localized formatted string for announcement in complex tables.

2026-03-10 Liam O'Neill: Addressed QA notes in the spec: added guidance for aria-live polite on incremental cost totals and role="status" only for error/important updates. Added acceptance criteria and QA checklist for engineering handoff. Ready for ENG review.
acceptance_criteria: All interactive regions in Cost, Rollouts, and Route detail panels have semantic landmarks (navigation/region/toolbar) with descriptive aria-labels.
Keyboard navigation: tab order is logical, arrow key behaviors within composite widgets (chart legends, token lists) are documented, and global shortcuts ignore IME composition sequences.
Color tokens updated so text and interactive controls meet WCAG AA for normal text and AAA for critical labels (as specified in the token table).
Screen reader reads localized currency/number formats correctly; where necessary, designs include aria-labels with preformatted localized strings.
Streaming/partial updates are handled with appropriate aria-live roles and do not create excessive verbosity for screen readers (QA-tested with VoiceOver, NVDA).
Design handoff includes Figma components, a component props table (ariaProps, keyboard hooks), and a short dev test checklist.
risk_and_mitigations: Risk: Global shortcut handler could break non-Latin IME input if composition events are not handled. Mitigation: engineering to implement compositionstart/compositionend guards and test with common IMEs (Japanese, Chinese, Korean).
Risk: Automated contrast fixes could alter brand tokens. Mitigation: tie changes to themed tokens and include a rollback token map; validate with design system owner.
Risk: Localized strings may expand and disrupt layout. Mitigation: add guidelines for truncation, wrapping, and RTL support; include test locales in QA matrix.
